what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Fiji, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters rose from 1109 in 2019 to 13580 in 2020.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Fiji list storms.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Fiji in these years.

when.text: The count fell to 259 by 2024; 2020 is the main year of displacement in the data.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 1500 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Fiji.
